scope: Map ACadSharp issue #1264's AutoCAD-authored TABLE block-cell value report to the official DXF field table and current libdxfrw parser/writer; refine PAR-126 controls without changing support claims.

method.kind: Read-only official DXF documentation, open-source issue review, and local source/test inspection
localInspection: src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_Table::parseCode group300/301/302/304 and block-reference handling
src/drw_entities.h: DRW_TableCellContent and DRW_TableCell typed representation
src/libdxfrw.cpp: dxfRW::writeTable complete-profile admission and ATTDEF closure
tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp: generated AC1021 block-cell parser vector
tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp: generated ASCII/binary TABLE block-cell, multi-content, and ATTDEF controls

evidence.observed: The issue reports that AutoCAD-saved DXFs for AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 samples decode block-cell CadValue as an empty string while the paired DWG path leaves a default unknown value. It quotes a DXF cell-value group sequence including group300 with an empty payload.
doesNotEstablish: raw file hashes or complete record context
the DWG byte layout or a normative interpretation of the value sequence

evidence.observed: The published TABLE entity reference assigns group300 to the text for a block-cell ATTDEF and separately documents groups301/302/303 as cell-value/text constructs.
doesNotEstablish: the issue's full group300 blank-value sequence inside CELL_VALUE framing
whether that sequence is valid for all AutoCAD versions or producer profiles

evidence.observed: The local DXF parser routes group300 to the last cell attribute and marks the TABLE snapshot incomplete when no attribute exists; the writer requires an admitted content profile and validates block and ATTDEF references.
doesNotEstablish: that the parser retains a complete semantic representation of the reported sequence
that linked or arbitrary multi-content TABLE writing is supported
